record.question: The Partition of India led to the creation of which two independent nations in 1947?
record.explanation: Answer A: India and Pakistan. The 1947 Partition created the independent dominions of India and Pakistan. Reference: https://www.britannica.com/event/ partition-of-India. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
